title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
quote: More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the companys agentic commerce ambitions. Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopifys catalog.

title: One Agent Development Kit, five languages
quote: Having five native languages in ADK means you dont have to pick a single runtime for your entire organization. Because every version of ADK speaks MCP and A2A, each component of your system can use the language that fits it best.

title: spec(extensions): delivery-receipt — signed, verifiable receipt of delivery for paid calls
quote: The extension is optional: it lets a resource server return a signed receipt of what it delivered for a paid call, covering the request, response digest, and settlement details. Opened 2026-10-12, still open and unmerged; implementation planned for a follow-up PR.
